summary.t: A tiger in a feathered headdress, every stripe painted one at a time.

text.t:
One of the larger pieces, and one of the slowest to make: the stripes go on one by one, and the headdress is built from coloured wooden feathers.

It sits with its tail curled round to the front. A piece with real presence — it works lit or unlit, and holds its own in daylight as an ornament.

options.power.help.t: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.engraving.help.t: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
